reuse.why: Changes the rule in the existing exported getScheduledAmount and replaces the five inline midpoint copies (schedule-template, forecast-schedules, updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule, computeSchedulePreviewTransactions) with calls to it; the desktop-client already used it.

duplication.why: Removes the duplicated midpoint expressions instead of updating each; the rule now exists once.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, the module every consumer already imports for schedule amounts.

scope.why: Only the amount rule, its call sites, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: One definition with a widened null-tolerant signature; schedule-template still keeps its own isbetween ? ... : value dispatch around the call, a small leftover.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All ranged-amount paths now go through getScheduledAmount.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts; every server site (schedule-template.ts, forecast-schedules.ts, schedules/app.ts updateActions and postTransactionForSchedule, computeSchedulePreviewTransactions) and the existing desktop-client callers use it.
